fields.summary: Every task-session interview for milestone 1 tasks 1-10, extracted by a script from the task sessions' Claude Code transcripts into an append-only record; the transcripts stay out of every repo. Each task's shipit agent asked questions with options it wrote, and the owner picked from them. Across the ten tasks the agents asked 197 questions. The owner accepted an agent option 193 times (at least 173 of them the option the agent marked recommended), typed one answer, and typed eleven more messages, all directions about shipping, merging, cleaning up branches and worktrees, and marking tasks done. Every design question went the agent's recommended way; the other picks were workflow choices (plan approval, fixing review findings before shipping, agent delegation, ship sign-off) and multi-select guardrail lists. Picked options are the agent's wording, accepted by the owner, so none is quoted here as the owner's words; the decisions they settled are the D-rows of each task's shipit plan. The orchestrator (the owner's main session) typed five answers into task sessions, recorded as not the owner's: a truncated close-out instruction to task 10, task 8's shared default-view amendment and its ship sign-off, and task 7's answers on change sets as link endpoints (already fixed on main) and on the CI read budget (50 ms, with speeding up roadmap and ready left as a follow-up). Topics by task: 1 code layout, lint, Go version, the testscript harness, CI, CLAUDE.md; 2 ULIDs, canonical JSON, strict reading, atomic writes, the log reader, the corpus; 3 operation revisions, lifecycle rules, strict bodies, node kinds, fractional keys; 4 the three views, causal order, field-level conflicts, history, conflict repair; 5 the pure-Go SQLite driver, index location, incremental catch-up, the generator, the budget test; 6 the api package, schemas, actors, references, apply, errors, lifecycle verbs; 7 the seven reads, default view, why, roadmap, ready, the read budget; 8 slice shape, the budget measure, constraint inheritance, cuts, the JSON shape; 9 render, check failures and warnings, the append-only base, ci install, the self-check; 10 status, source add, size caps, guide topics, install and the session-start hook. Nothing in the record is left open beyond the follow-ups it mentions.
